title: Historic Honky Tonk Hideaway
description:
Historic 1BR condo in Downtown Nashville—now with new owners & a Superhost! Close to everything, with a parking pass included. Walk to top sights & music venues, but relax away from Broadway’s noise. Main floor unit with Queen bed, sleeper sofa, air mattress, fast WiFi, and local charm. Perfect for couples, groups, or business stays! Traveling with a larger group? We have another unit in this building! Ask about our 2-bedroom condo that sleeps 6.

The space
This Airbnb is managed by a team with over 40 years experience in the hospitality and philanthropic industry. It's a super clean condo cleaned with safe and natural cleaning products. The condo is located on a quiet street, but close to everything in downtown. Enjoy!

Guest access
You'll have the entire condo and the city of Nashville to enjoy!

Other things to note
-Free Parking!
